verdict.rationale: Reflect publishes a full API reference as an OpenAPI 3.0 package on openpm, linked from its own docs and covering graphs, links, daily notes, notes and users/me. The API docs also include a copy-paste curl example against the live REST base, which is runnable but not interactive. Nothing shows an interactive explorer or in-browser runnable examples, and no sandbox or test environment is documented. Missing for 10: interactive try-it explorer, in-browser runnable examples, sandbox/test environment, per-endpoint examples, independent corroboration.
